findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_series, get_public_holidays_worldwide, get_filing_deadlines, get_changes, get_calendar · Private data: get_public_holidays_worldwide, get_key_balance, verify_answer_receipt, register_alert · Public sink: get_public_holidays_worldwide, get_key_balance, invoice_payable, verify_answer_receipt, register_alert · Destructive: get_key_balance, validate_tax_id.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_series, get_public_holidays_worldwide, get_filing_deadlines, get_changes, get_calendar · Private data: get_public_holidays_worldwide, get_key_balance, verify_answer_receipt, register_alert · Public sink: get_public_holidays_worldwide, get_key_balance, invoice_payable, verify_answer_receipt, register_alert · Destructive: get_key_balance, validate_tax_id

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
